_doc: Battle Pyramid lobby (Emerald 15x18). The hall (rows 13-17) with the exit mat (7,17); the attendant's corridor up the middle (7, 8-12; Emerald's staircase) to the upper hall (rows 5-7) and the floor panel (7,4) that takes the player into the Pyramid (Emerald's blue panel: the floor's exit model is the same blue). Emerald's statues and torches on the upper hall's wall tiles stand as blocks; the results PC (5,12) and the rules board (1,12) on the hall's back wall. (em_rooms 2026-10-19: no potted plants at (0,13) / (14,13): Emerald has none there, the hint giver stood in one and the player walked through the other.)

mats._what: exit mat (Emerald's mat and warp (7,17); em_rooms 2026-10-19)
